equations.sigma: sigma - sigma_n - K * trace(de) * I - 2 * G * dev(de)

model_definitions.name: Drucker–Prager, nonassociated perfect plasticity
model_definitions.description: Drucker–Prager cone f=q-M p-c with separate dilatancy slope Md. Backward Euler with declarative trial-direction radial return and subgradient apex branch. Constant elasticity; no hardening or tensile cap.

sources.locator: Drucker–Prager yield and flow conventions; this entry is the explicitly stated perfect-plastic specialization

plastic_integrator: smooth-cone correction under zero hardening; atlas omits separate tensile cutoff. Trial-direction elimination and apex subgradient are project derivations documented in docs/models/drucker-prager-apex.md.
Equations 17–23 (radial scaling) and Apex Stress Correction; comparison source includes a separate tensile cutoff absent from this atlas law. Project derivation: docs/models/drucker-prager-apex.md.

equations.sigma: sigma - sigma_n - K * trace(de) * I - 2 * G * dev(de) + min(3 * G * gamma / trial_q_safe, 1) * trial_s - gamma * K * Md * I

model_definitions.name: Modified Cam Clay
model_definitions.description: Associated Modified Cam Clay with endpoint pressure/void-ratio dependent elasticity, exponential log-pc hardening and exponential volume bookkeeping. Project finite-step choices documented in the source dossier; demonstration initialization; finite rotation unsupported.

sources.locator: Silbermann & Nagel, 28 June 2023: equations 14–17 and 30b; equation 11 prints M while 30b uses M squared. Section 3.1 hardening differs from atlas exponential log-pc update. Project discretization and normalization: docs/models/modified-cam-clay.md.
Equations 15, 18–25: stiffness, yield and associated flow; 31 and 8 have different finite-step hardening/volume updates. Initialization: 32 and 42. Not an executed cross-code comparison.

equations.sigma: sigma - sigma_n - K * trace(de) * I - 2 * G * dev(de) + gamma * (6 * G * dev(sigma) / pc_n + K * M**2 * (2 * mean - pc) / pc_n * I)
equations.pc: pc - pc_n * exp((1 + e) * plastic_volume / (lambda_c - kappa))
